description: The authored player-profile seed palette and picker tuning.

identities.description: The identities used to seed an absent owned-world directory.

items.description: One authored identity used to seed an owned world.

neutralColor.description: The placeholder color used when no profile identity is available.

colorSequence.description: The deterministic sequence used for generated profile colors.

name.description: The sequence name: None, Index, Additive, R1, or R2.

offset.description: The signed phase added to the caller's stable index before sampling.

step.description: The turn-sized increment for Additive; zero for every other sequence.

saturation.description: The saturation used for generated colors.

value.description: The brightness used for generated colors.

colorSearchLimit.description: The number of generated colors checked before accepting the next sequence value.

noseFactor.description: The body-color multiplier used for avatar accents.

pickerThreshold.description: The stick magnitude that cycles a pending profile choice.

pickerNeutralBlend.description: The pending-avatar blend amount toward PickerNeutralColor.

seatLook.description: The control feel a seat of this document wakes with. REQUIRED — there is no engine fallback, so a document either states what its seats should feel like or fails validation. Read per seat from whichever document owns it: the world's for an unclaimed seat, the joined identity's own for a claimed one, which is how a player's feel travels with their profile (see WorldSeatLook).

yawSensitivity.description: The yaw response in radians per pixel of raw (un-accelerated) pointer motion along the X axis.

pitchSensitivity.description: The pitch response in radians per pixel of raw pointer motion along the Y axis.

invertYaw.description: Whether the yaw response is inverted.

invertPitch.description: Whether the pitch response is inverted.

minPitch.description: The pitch clamp floor in radians.

maxPitch.description: The pitch clamp ceiling in radians.

worldAxes.description: Whether the live orbit composes onto world axes rather than the seat body's own facing (an absolute orbit versus one that rides the body's yaw).
